entry.title: Lumen 2: lab releases smaller open model with longer context window
entry.summary: An AI lab has released Lumen 2, an open model that handles very long prompts.

entry.title: Government opens consultation on AI rules for public services
entry.summary: The ministry has asked for comments on a draft framework for using AI in government services.

entry.title: New budget smartphone launches with a bigger battery
entry.summary: The phone said to cost under Rs 12,000 has a 6,000 mAh battery.
